title: Auth + quota + response schema trigger release baseline plus two triggered specialists (invariants, security)
task: Implement allocate(tenant_id, requested, current, max_allowed). R1: deny when tenant_id is empty with reason 'unauthorized'. R2: grant requested when current + requested <= max_allowed with reason 'ok'; deny with reason 'over_quota' otherwise. R3: response shape is always {granted:int, reason:str, remaining:int}; never expose internal counters. I1: a missing tenant must never reach the quota math.
